steps.description:
Background Check Type names the screening you ran: Criminal Record, Driving, Child Safety. Keep one record per check, so a volunteer screened yearly has a row per year.

Pick a Check Type to continue.
steps.label: Type of Check
steps.title: Type of Check

steps.description: Requested and Pending both mean not yet cleared. Treat only Cleared as a pass before someone works with children. Cleared, Not Cleared and Expired each need a Completed On date before the record will save.
steps.label: Status
steps.title: Status

steps.description: Left blank it fills itself from the check type's Valid For (Years) once Completed On is set, and a type set to 0 years never expires. A daily job then flips a Cleared check to Expired on the day it lapses, so nobody has to watch the list.
steps.label: Expiry
steps.title: Expiry

steps.description: Attach the result here instead of leaving it in somebody's inbox. Anyone who can read the record can open the attachment, so keep this doctype's permissions tight.
steps.label: The Provider's Report
steps.title: The Provider's Report
